title: CGST Delhi South observes GST Pakhwada 2026 with stakeholder outreach and recognition of excellence
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Finance

CGST Delhi South observes GST Pakhwada 2026 with stakeholder outreach and recognition of excellence

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
01 JUL 2026 5:39PM by PIB Delhi

In observance of GST Day 2026, under the theme “सुगम कर व्यवस्था, सशक्त राष्ट्र” (Simple Tax System, Strong Nation), the CGST Delhi South Commissionerate organised a series of activities under GST Pakhwada 2026, reaffirming its commitment to taxpayer facilitation and participative governance.

As part of the initiative, divisions including Okhla, Connaught Place and Vasant Kunj, among others, conducted outreach programmes in their respective jurisdictions, engaging taxpayers and tax professionals to promote awareness, address concerns and strengthen voluntary compliance.

The Commissionerate also organised ‘Samvad’— an Open Dialogue and Grievance-Redressal Session, chaired by the Commissioner, CGST Delhi South, and attended by Additional, Deputy and Assistant Commissioners. The programme witnessed participation from representatives of the embassies of Iraq and Singapore, trade associations, and stakeholders from the hotel, aviation, transport and construction sectors. The Commissioner welcomed taxpayers as partners in financial nation-building, while officers attentively addressed issues and suggestions raised by participants.

As part of the celebrations, Certificates of Commendation were conferred upon twenty officers across various ranks in recognition of their exemplary service, professionalism and contribution to a robust, transparent and citizen-centric tax administration. The Commissionerate resolved to continue such engagements regularly, further strengthening trust and collaboration with all stakeholders.
